item.title: WP Recipe Maker Arbitrary Shortcode Execution via Approved Recipe Rating Comments (CVE-2026-89274)
item.description: Critical severity (CVSS 9.1) — web · CVE-2026-89274. Status: PoC — exploit path is implemented and verifiable, but limited: it requires the malicious comment to be approved before execution, and demonstrated impact is shortcode-output disclosure, not code execution. Affects: WP Recipe Maker plugin for WordPress (wp-recipe-maker). Tags: WordPress, WP-Recipe-Maker, shortcode-injection, CWE-94, unauthenticated, plugin, JSON-LD, comment-approval, data-disclosure, Python.
